name: standart-npc
author: MondoTruth, Lil Art, IceGlaive, Nokzin, iguera, Claude, and the Ragnarok Offline community
description: ⚠ Some NPCs may need the Cash Shop for full functionality. Turning the mod on turns on every NPC; switch single ones off with Settings… (Warper, Job Master, Reset Girl, Stylist, Episode Valkyrie and all the others).

settings.label: Switched-off NPCs
settings.description: Filled in by the Settings… window: the NPCs without a setting of their own (Warper, Buffer, Job Master, Reset Girl, Stylist, Episode Valkyrie, Falcon Breeder, Kafra Employee, Weight Maxxer, Plagiarism Master, Tool Dealer, Smuggler, Card Exchanger, Safe Refiner, Grade Refiner, Universal Enchanter, Master Nokzin, Daily Rewards) that are unticked there. Empty = all on.

settings.label: Buffer: buffs
settings.description: Filled in by the Settings… window (Buffer → Choose buffs): the buffs the Buffer casts, as a comma-separated list of codes.

settings.label: Bounty Hunter
settings.description: Hunting contracts at the Bounty Hunter, Prontera (147,172); one contract per board at a time. Target Hunt (was Gramps): pick a map, Lv 70-231+ (Pre-renewal: to 125), EXP. Overlook Water Dungeon: Lv 30-85, 4 floors in order; all 4 = a card of your choice. Illusion Dungeons (Renewal only): 9 dungeons, Lv 99+, EXP. Daily Area Purge (was Lucky John): 500 kills a day in a random area, EXP and Zeny.

settings.label: Cheffenia MVP Dungeon
settings.description: Timed MVP dungeon access, paid in Zeny or Cash Points. Prontera (140,180).

settings.label: Training Dummies
settings.description: Stationary target dummies for testing damage output: a Medium-size and a Large-size one. Prontera (153,163) and (158,163).
